Melbin George Bengaluru, Karnataka, India melbingeorge17@gmail.com — linkedin.com/in/melbin-george — github.com/melbingeorge23

Summary

Software Engineer with 2.2 years of experience building scalable backend systems and distributed microservices. Skilled in Java, Python, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Angular/React, and cloud technologies like AWS and Azure. Experienced in CI/CD automation, production debugging, distributed architectures, and performance optimisation.

Work Experience

Software Engineer Molsys Pvt. Ltd., Mangaluru • Built backend services using Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, MySQL; improved API performance by 35% using caching

Aug 2023 – Oct 2025

and query tuning

Designed microservices with Redis caching, asynchronous messaging, and horizontal scalability • Developed full-stack applications using React/Angular + Spring Boot with JWT authentication • Automated CI/CD using Docker, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS ECS; reduced deployment time by 60% • Managed AWS infrastructure: EC2, ECS, S3, IAM, RDS, CloudWatch, SQS • Improved reliability via structured logging, dashboards, alerts, and RCA processes • Mentored junior developers and led backend/system design discussions Education

B.E. – Computer Science and Engineering Yenepoya Institute of Technology, Mangaluru

2019 – 2023

Projects

Distributed Task Processing Engine • Reduced processing time by 40% using Redis queues and asynchronous workers • Implemented AWS SQS + Lambda event-driven architecture improving throughput by 60% • Achieved 99.5% uptime using CloudWatch alerts and auto-scaling • Designed a horizontally scalable system handling 10K+ parallel tasks

Spring Boot, Redis, AWS, MySQL

Achievements & Certifications

LeetCode: Solved 150+ Problems

Certifications: Globally Responsible Engineering Virtual Experience (Forage) — Android App Dev using Kotlin (IIT Bombay) — Python Programming (IIT Bombay)
